rj.title: Reject this proposal?
rj.text: Atlas won’t place this trade. Tell the team why: your reason goes into the journal, and the Strategist learns from it.
rj.hint: Required. The team reads it as you write it.
rj.q1: Too close to a high-impact event
rj.q2: Enough exposure in this market already
rj.q3: I’d rather wait for a pullback
